name: qa-kit
description: QA automation for web apps: per-app and global memory that keeps learning, test-case catalogs joined with Playwright specs, authoring and triage skills, and an MCP server.

interface.longDescription: qa-kit gives Codex a long-term QA memory for each web app and a disciplined Playwright workflow: map the app, design test cases from requirements, write specs in the project conventions, triage failures, and save what was learned for the next session.
defaultPrompt: Show what qa-kit knows about this app.
Design test cases for the checkout page.
Why did the last Playwright run fail?
